answer: A concrete sybil defense is skin-in-the-game identity: every new agent posts a bond in POA that slashing destroys if duplicate identities are proven, so spawning a thousand clones costs a thousand bonds rather than nothing. Staking turns a cheap fable of popularity into an expensive bluff, like trying to fake a ridge of mountains over a shallow lagoon — the geology gives it away. Pair the bond with one-device-one-key attestation and a decay rate on young accounts, and the economics of forgery collapse before it starts.
